jobs.description:
For a company based in Veurne, specialised in metalworking, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to work in various shift systems.

You will be working in an ultra-modern production environment that meets the highest standards in terms of quality, productivity and innovation. A very interesting opportunity for you!

Your responsibilities:

• As a Maintenance Technician, you will support customers with their maintenance activities.
• You will mainly be responsible for preventive and corrective maintenance, repairs and the replacement of spare parts on industrial installations.
• You are able to work independently and are skilled in assembling and dismantling mechanical components.
• You will mainly work as part of the customer's technical maintenance team, always respecting the safety regulations applicable on site.
• You are responsible for accurately completing work orders and providing daily reports to the internal department.
• You work autonomously and maintain good communication with the customer.
• You have strong analytical skills to identify and troubleshoot technical faults and defects.
For this challenging position, you naturally need to have the right skills and experience.

• You have a strong ELECTRICAL & MECHANICAL BACKGROUND, with at least 5 years of experience as an industrial electrician.
• You are flexible regarding work locations, as you will work at different sites on a project basis.
• You are open to working in shifts (2-shift system, day shifts or night shifts – NEGOTIABLE).
• You are independent, eager to learn and not afraid of getting your hands dirty.
• You hold a valid category B driving licence and speak fluent DUTCH OR ENGLISH.

Are you passionate about metal, steel, engineering, welding, overhead cranes, or forklifts?

We are currently looking for several profiles to work in a two-shift system or a fixed night shift in Zwevezele.

We are recruiting for the following positions:

• Press brake operators
• Forklift drivers
• Loaders and unloaders
• Overhead crane operators
• Saw machine operators
• General metalworking machine operators

Your profile

• You bring a healthy dose of enthusiasm and motivation.
• You have experience working with machines and a strong interest in technology, or experience operating a forklift.
• You have solid technical insight.
• You have a very good knowledge of Dutch and/or English.
• You are available to work Monday to Friday in a two-shift system or a fixed night shift.
Working hours:

• Morning shift: starts at 5:00 or 6:00 AM, depending on the department.
• Afternoon shift: starts at 1:00 or 2:00 PM.
• Night shift: starts on Monday evening at 9:00 or 10:00 PM. On Fridays, the schedule is adjusted so you start and finish earlier, allowing you to begin the weekend sooner.

Do you enjoy precision shaping pipes and creating strong welds for technical installations? As a TIG or semi-automatic welder, you'll work on a variety of HVAC projects within the construction sector. You'll read plans, build custom installations, and weld pipes into perfect assemblies for heating and plumbing. Depending on the project, you'll work both on-site and in the workshop, preparing and assembling components. Thanks to the variety of high-end projects, your job remains technically challenging and educational. You'll be part of a large team where collaboration, quality, and safety are paramount.

What are your tasks?

• Reading and interpreting technical plans

• Bending, grinding, and welding pipes (TIG/semi-automatic)

• Preparing and assembling installations in the workshop and on-site

• Experience as a welder in a technical or construction environment

• Communicate in English or Romanian

• Possession of a driver's license

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!

• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.

• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.

• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.

• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.

• You have a very good knowledge of English, spoken and written.

You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

You will be a member of the SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.

• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.

• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.

• You contribute to achieving targets.

• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.

• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  

• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  

• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.

• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

 Your new roleAs Logistics Engineering Manager, you are responsible for designing, optimizing and further professionalizing logistics processes within a complex warehouse and production environment.

Based in Evergem, you will work in a large-scale production logistics environment where speed, reliability, safety and continuous improvement are essential.Engineering is at the heart of the organization. You will have significant autonomy to critically assess existing processes, design new solutions and turn improvement opportunities into tangible results on the shop floor.

 
You combine logistics engineering and continuous improvement with project and people management, while maintaining a strong presence on the shop floor and staying closely connected to daily operations. Your key responsibilities include:

For a leading manufacturer in the machine building industry in the region, we are looking for a dedicated Senior Electrical Engineer.

In this key engineering role, you will act as the technical owner for the complete electrical hardware design, ensuring every machine meets the highest quality and safety standards!

As Senior Electrical Engineer, you will take full ownership of the electrical engineering lifecycle:

• Concept & Project Planning: Participate in multidisciplinary project design meetings with mechanical and software engineers from the concept phase onwards, creating realistic project schedules and milestones.
• Electrical Design (EPLAN P8 & ProPanel): Translate draft electrical descriptions and specifications into clear, detailed hardware guidelines. Design and adapt electrical schematics in EPLAN P8 and create 3D panel/enclosure layouts in EPLAN ProPanel.
• Standards & Compliance: Ensure all designs strictly comply with European directives and international regulations (e.g., EN 60204, Machinery Directive, EMC, LVD).
• ERP & Production Follow-Up: Create and update ERP work orders for customer-specific projects and master BOMs for standard machinery. Closely monitor electrical assembly during the build phase in the workshop.
• Standardization & Mentorship: Develop, maintain, and continuously improve electrical design guidelines and best practices. Review schematics with colleagues, offer technical guidance, and actively drive departmental standardization initiatives.

• Education & Experience: You hold a Master’s degree in Industrial Sciences (Electromechanics / Electrotechnics) or possess equivalent experience. You have at least 5 years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably within the machine building sector.
• Software & Standards: Strong proficiency in EPLAN P8 is required (hands-on experience with EPLAN ProPanel is a major plus). Solid working knowledge of European electrical safety standards (familiarity with UL standards for the North American market is an asset).
• Key Strengths: You possess an analytical mindset, excellent problem-solving skills, and a structured way of working.
• Languages & Communication: Excellent communication skills in both English and Dutch, with a collaborative team spirit suited for an international environment.

About the role 

The Finance & HR Officer is responsible for the day-to-day administration of IVAA's human resources and finances. The role ensures the smooth coordination of monthly payroll, employee administration, invoices, payments and financial records. 

Working closely with the Secretary General and the Treasurer, as well as external service providers, the officer maintains accurate and up-to-date administrative and financial information and supports regular financial monitoring and reporting. 

The position requires a highly organised, reliable and discreet individual who can manage several administrative processes independently while working within the organisation's established procedures and approval arrangements. 

Key responsibilities 

Finances 

• Receive, organise and file incoming and outgoing invoices and supporting financial documentation. 
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of income and expenditure in the organisation's financial tracking system or accounting software. 
• Carry out monthly bank reconciliations and monitor the organisation's cash position. 
• Provide regular financial overviews for the Treasurer and the Secretary General.  
• Support periodic financial reporting and the preparation of documents required by the Treasurer, external accountants or auditors, where applicable. 
• Monitor expenditure against the approved budget and respond to routine financial queries. 
• Issue receipts for payments received, including membership payments and fees, and maintain a corresponding record. 
• Contribute to the selection and set-up of accounting software 
• Coordinate and process payments to employees, contractors, partners and service providers. 
• Process employee and partner reimbursement requests in accordance with the organisation's procedures. 
• Maintain a register of contracts with partners, contractors and service providers, and monitor payment schedules, invoicing and amounts against contract terms. 
HR administration 

• Prepare and submit monthly payroll information for all employees to the external payroll service provider. 
• Coordinate with the provider to ensure payroll inputs are accurate, complete and submitted on time. 
• Coordinate employee-related payroll changes, including starters, leavers, absences and changes to employment conditions. 
• Act as the first point of contact for employees on routine HR and administrative matters, including leave, certificates, employee details and benefits. 
• Maintain complete, accurate and confidential employee files and HR records. 
• Coordinate the administration of employment contracts, leave records and other employment documentation. 
• Coordinate employee admin onboarding and offboarding, ensuring that the necessary documentation, registrations and administrative arrangements are completed. 
External service providers 

• Liaise with service providers and public administrations as required. 
• Administer the relevant online platforms used for invoices, payments and financial documentation. 
• Coordinate contracting processes with service providers, in collaboration with the Secretary General. 
Other tasks 

• Coordinate general office logistics (office cleaning, maintenance, repair services...) 
• Manage office supplies, stationery and equipment. 
• Any other tasks as required 
 

 
 
Skills and qualifications 

• Bachelor's degree (haute école or university) in accounting, finance, HR management, finance, administration or a related field. 
• At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in finance administration and payroll/HR administration (minimum: finance administration and demonstrated exposure to payroll/HR administration). 
• Solid knowledge of bookkeeping, invoice processing, payment administration, reimbursements and budget monitoring. 
• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, and financial reporting. 
• Experience with accounting software, including set-up, is an advantage. 
• Knowledge of Belgian payroll and employment administration (e.g. working with a social secretariat) is an advantage. 
• Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and a systematic approach to record-keeping. 
• High level of discretion and integrity when handling confidential employee, contractual and financial information. 
• Clear, professional and friendly communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with employees, management and external partners. 
• Ability to work independently while recognising when to seek guidance or approval. 
Languages: Working proficiency in English and French is required.
